d.t: A FINE WHITE POLYMER FORTIFIED FLEXIBLE SAND AND SILICA FREE CEMENT-BASED WALL TILE ADHESIVE
d.s: SikaTile-374 Mega Pro is a fine white, polymer fortified, flexible, sand and silica free cement-based tile adhesive, suitable for tile and stone internal wall tiling applications.
a: White colour suitable for light and opaque stone (not sensitive to moisture)
Suitable over Sika under tile waterproofing membranes
us: SikaTile-374 Mega Pro is suitable for fixing tile and stone by thin bed application for internal applications. SUITABLE TILE TYPES ARE; • Ceramic Tiles • Porcelain Tiles • Natural Stone (non moisture sensitive stone) • Manufactured Stone (non moisture sensitive stone) • Mosaics SUITABLE SUBSTRATES INCLUDE; • Concrete (concrete greater than 35Mpa compressive strength requires mechanical preparation) • Compressed Cement Boards* • Ceramic Tile underlay / Fibre Cement boards* • Cement-baseds renders • Sika approved under tile waterproof membranes • Cement renders • Gypsum Plasterboard *refer to board manufacturers instructions for further details and load limits.

sec.t: If unopened 12 months from date of manufacture
Store in dry cool conditions, elevated out of direct sunlight
6.5 - 7 Litres of clean, cool potable water per 20kg bag

USE | WAIT TIME Grouting on walls | 12 hours Dry area service | 24 hours Wet area service | 5 days All application information date is determined at laboratory conditions: 23°C & 50% RH. Higher temperatures will reduce times and lower temperatures with increase times.
Notched trowel size | Approximate coverage per bag 6mm | 9.5m2 10mm | 6m2 Consumption is dependant of surface profile, and application technique.
Personal protective equipment Mixing Buckets Mixing drill with stirring attachment Trowels

All substrates shall meet minimum deflection standards outlined in the Australian Standards AS 3958:2023 All substrates shall be free from loose friable materials, dust, debris, release agents, curing compounds, grease, sealers and other contaminating materials. Contaminated substrates must be mechanically prepared to expose at least 80% of the original substrate. For substrates that require a levelling compound use a suitable Sika faring coat /skim coat. CONCRETE SUBSTRATES: New concrete shall be cured for 28 days and be left with a wood float finish. Steel trowel finished concrete is generally acceptable if the concrete allows water penetration. Concrete above 35Mpa shall be mechanically prepared. CEMENT BOARDS AND SHEETING: All boards and sheets must be fixed in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions and specifically designed for tiling. RENDERS: Cement-based renders must be installed as per AS 3958:2023 and left for a minimum 24 hours prior to tiling. Renders may need longer drying time in cold climtes.

Substrates shall be primed prior to adhesive application. Porous substrates can be primed with: SikaTile 010 Secure Prime Davco Ultraprime Davco PrimeX Non Porous Substrates can be primed with: SikaTile 015 Prep n Prime Note: Refer to the specific product data sheet for the complete user instructions prior to use. Do not apply primers over waterproofing membranes.

Pour clean cool water into a mixing bucket and gradually pour the the SikaTile-374 Mega Pro powder into the bucket and stir with a mixing drill). Mix for 2-3 minutes to a smooth lump free homogeneous consistency. Allow the product to stand (slake) for 5 minutes then restir for an additional minute. Do not add more water. Restirring the mixture may be required during the adhesives pot life.

Tiles shall be fixed in accordance to with AS 3958:2023 Ensure the backs of tiles are clean and free from dust and contaminates. Apply the adhesive to the substrate with the appropriate sized notched trowel to achieve coverage requirement on both substrate and the back of the tile. Tiles may require back-buttering to achieve minimum coverage requirements. Apply the adhesive with a notched trowel in a single direction. Apply the tile, while pressing into the wet adhesive, break the ridges with the tile to fully bed the tile into the adhesive. It is advisable to periodically check the backs of the tiles for adhesive coverage requirements as the AS3958:2023. Only apply as must adhesive that can be covered prior to adhesive skinning. If skinning occurs remove and replace with fresh adhesive. Remove any excess adhesive from the face of the tile with a damp sponge and ensure grout joint are of uniform depth. Movement, expansion and control joints must be installed as per AS 3958:2023. Allow adhesive to dry prior to grouting.
Tools and equipment can be cleaned with water while the adhesive is still wet.

storage.label: Conditions for safe storage
storage.text: Store in original container. Keep in a well-ventilated place. Observe label precautions. Store in accordance with local regulations.

storage.label: Further information on storage stability
storage.text: Keep in a dry place. No decomposition if stored and applied as directed.

handling.label: Advice on protection against fire and explosion
handling.text: Avoid dust formation. Provide appropriate exhaust ventilation at places where dust is formed.

handling.label: Advice on safe handling
handling.text: Avoid exceeding the given occupational exposure limits (see section 8). Do not get in eyes, on skin, or on clothing. For personal protection see section 8. Persons with a history of skin sensitisation problems or asthma, allergies, chronic or recurrent respiratory disease should not be employed in any process in which this mixture is being used. Smoking, eating and drinking should be prohibited in the application area. Follow standard hygiene measures when handling chemical products Sika 03 Do not breathe vapours/dust.

handling.label: Hygiene measures
handling.text: Handle in accordance with good industrial hygiene and safety practice. When using do not eat or drink. When using do not smoke. Wash hands before breaks and at the end of workday.

respiratory.label: Respiratory protection
respiratory.text: In case of inadequate ventilation wear respiratory protection. Respirator selection must be based on known or anticipated exposure levels, the hazards of the product and the safe working limits of the selected respirator. particulate filter P

hands.label: Hand protection
hands.text: Chemical-resistant, impervious gloves complying with an approved standard should be worn at all times when handling chemical products if a risk assessment indicates this is necessary. Follow AS/NZS 1337.1 Recommended: Butyl rubber, PVC, cotton gloves

skin_body.label: Skin and body protection
skin_body.text: Protective clothing (e.g. safety shoes, long-sleeved working clothing, long trousers) Follow AS 2210:3

engineering_controls.label: Appropriate engineering controls
engineering_controls.text: Avoid dust formation. Provide appropriate exhaust ventilation at places where dust is formed.

std.context: Use product in accordance with Australian Standards AS 3958:2023 The Installation of Ceramic & Stone Tiles.
All substrates shall meet minimum deflection standards outlined in the Australian Standards AS 3958:2023
Cement-based renders must be installed as per AS 3958:2023 and left for a minimum 24 hours prior to tiling.
Tiles shall be fixed in accordance to with AS 3958:2023
It is advisable to periodically check the backs of the tiles for adhesive coverage requirements as the AS3958:2023.
